budget_charged_units.description: Reported tokens plus allowances for unreported usage; not an invoiced amount.

reserved_units.description: Input-capacity allowance for unreported usage, capped by remaining run budget; not measured tokens or a billing limit.

facts.description: At most 32 flat string, number or boolean facts; encoded facts must be at most 8000 bytes. Keys are 1-120 characters and string values at most 1000 characters.

EvidenceSummary.description: Evidence index metadata with bounded presentation labels. Retrieve /evidence/{id} for exact content; no facts or request/result payloads are included.
